changes.summary: Implemented the shared Sheets foundation for the Sprint 17 totales por caja pattern.
code: Added depositos_totales, retiros_totales, bonos_totales and retiros_no_pagados to backend/config/sheetsSchema.js.
Exported TOTALES_POR_CAJA_HEADERS as the shared sheet shape for the four modules.
Made backend/scripts/setupSheets.js skip header rewrites when a sheet is already aligned and guarded direct execution with require.main.
Added backend/tests/setupSheets.test.js and wired it into backend/package.json test.
